description: This file defines a React functional component named Board, which renders a 3x3 grid of Square components for a Tic Tac Toe game. It takes 'squares' array and 'onSquareClick' callback as props and uses them to display each square with appropriate ARIA attributes for accessibility.

methods.name: Board({ squares, onSquareClick })
